Name: Farming Dream
Author: MorroZ
Description:
[center][size=3][b]#Farming Dream#[/b][/size][/center]

[center]Farming Dream is a reworked Farm Map with Visual changes and more, mostly made for myself but i tought i can share it.[/center][center]This map will be updated so check back from time to time, also if u have ideas, post them and maybe i implent them.[/center][center]if u wonder why there isn`t a Farmhouse/Greenhouse on the Images...
...i was lazy and made the Screenshots in the Editor which isn`t showing these Buildings :P[/center]


[b][u]Main Version [size=1](with grass+small pond)[/size]:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*]Ponds got Removed and a new one Placed over the Farming House/Around the Spouse Area + One on the Lower left side.
[*]Some Hill Formations on the Sides got removed which opened more Space to Build on.
[*]Aesthetic changes around the map has been made.
[*]Several small Pathing changes (trees/rocks/fiber etc.)
[*]Buildings/Objects can be placed on the left side.
[/list]

[b][u]Optional Version [size=1](without grass and small pond)[/size]:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*]Basicly the same as on the Main Version except the fact the left side is Free from anything to create a clean map.
[*]Ponds got Removed and a new one Placed over the Farming House/Around the Spouse Area.
[*]Some Hill Formations on the Sides got removed which opened more Space to Build on.
[*]Aesthetic changes around the map has been made.
[*]Several small Pathing changes (trees/rocks/fiber etc.)
[*]Note: no further Features are getting added, maybe some small changes but nothing that takes the clean look away.
[/list]

[b][u]Installation:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*]Backup your Original Farm.xnb (name it Farm.xnb_backup)
[list]
[*][b]Steam:[/b] C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps
[*][b]GOG:[/b] C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps\)
[/list][*]Place the new Farm.xnb u want to use in the Maps folder mentioned above.
[*]... and play!
[/list]

[u][b]Notes:[/b][/u] u could play with ur current savegame without any mayor problems, but i recommend u to start a new game, if u have ideas or find bugs, please dont hesitate to post them.

Credits should go to the Autor of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/270/?]FancyFarm[/url] which gave me the idea of making a map, since i wanted a clean one and his version isnt updated anymore.
